items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Wilson; wonderful, a lovely human being.

ctx.x: Teddy Wilson; wonderful, a lovely human being. And Fletcher, a very kind human being. Fletcher's wife I used to--Fletcher's wife used to copy from Benny and I'd run things down there at three thirty, four o'clock in the morning and never a problem.
She lived on 138th Street and Lenox Avenue somewhere. Don't go there alone now, especially if you're white. But in those days they didn't do anything.
